#926 Deploy steps
926.1  Run the deploy steps now?
  Three commands, run in this order:

  1. Build: just build
  2. Upload:

  [1] copy
   aws s3 sync ./dist s3://example-bucket/app --delete --exclude '*.map' --cache-control m 
   ax-age=31536000,immutable                                                               

  3. Check:

  [2] copy
   curl -s -o /dev/null \                           
     -w "%{http_code}\n" https://example.com/health 

  • Rollback is just rollback.
│ The bucket is the staging one.
a) Run: an agent runs all three
b) Hold: nothing runs  ← rec

  b  ← rec
